About AI Integrated Solutions

AI Integrated Solutions helps businesses automate operations, generate and qualify leads, improve customer communication, streamline hiring, reduce overhead, and scale through practical AI-powered systems.

We're looking for a hands-on AI Automation & Integration Engineer who can take a client's business problem and build a reliable, production-ready solution.

This is not primarily a machine-learning research position. We're looking for someone who knows how to integrate today's AI platforms, APIs, CRMs, communication systems, and automation tools into real businesses.

What You'll Build

Projects may include:

AI voice receptionists
AI sales and appointment-setting agents
Automated lead capture and qualification
SMS, email, and voice follow-up systems
CRM automations
AI-powered customer service
AI hiring and candidate pre-screening
Automated outbound prospecting
Internal business workflow automation
AI knowledge bases and RAG systems
Custom API integrations
Reporting and notification systems

Technical Skills We're Looking For

Strong experience with several of the following:

GoHighLevel
n8n and/or Make
OpenAI and other LLM APIs
REST APIs
Webhooks
JSON
Twilio
Voice AI platforms such as Vapi or Retell
Python and/or JavaScript
CRM integrations
PostgreSQL / Supabase or similar databases
RAG and AI knowledge-base systems
OAuth/API authentication
Git/GitHub
Cloud deployment
Error handling, monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting

What Matters Most

We're looking for a builder, not someone who simply knows how to use ChatGPT.

You should be able to:

Understand a client's existing business process.
Identify opportunities for AI and automation.
Design the technical workflow.
Connect multiple platforms through APIs and webhooks.
Build and deploy the solution.
Test it thoroughly.
Troubleshoot problems.
Document what you've built.
Maintain and improve systems after deployment.

How to Apply

Please send:

A short introduction
Your résumé or LinkedIn profile
Examples of AI automations you've personally built
A description of your role on each project
The platforms/APIs used
Your hourly rate or preferred compensation structure

Important: Please include at least one example of an AI system you personally took from concept through deployment.

Selected applicants will be invited to a short interview and paid technical evaluation.

Pay: $30.00 - $40.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote
